title: Hidden States as Early Signals: Step-level Trace Evaluation and Pruning for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Zhixiang Liang、Beichen Huang、Zheng Wang、Minjia Zhang（机构：伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳—香槟分校）
paper_type_zh: 高效并行测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 部署自一致性类推理、且 GPU 内存压力与排队而非单纯词元数决定延迟的读者。
one_line: STEP prunes low-promise reasoning traces using step-end hidden states when KV-cache pressure rises, reducing parallel test-time latency without sacrificing accuracy.
STEP 在 KV 缓存压力上升时，根据步骤末端隐藏状态剪去低前景推理轨迹，以降低并行测试时延迟而不牺牲准确率。
why: It connects trace-quality signals to an actual serving-system trigger, showing that compute allocation must consider KV-cache scheduling as well as model reasoning.
inclusion_reason: It controls the number of active parallel reasoning traces from early hidden-state evidence and GPU-memory pressure, directly optimizing the inference accuracy-latency trade-off.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Parallel sampling improves reasoning accuracy but keeps many long traces alive even after some have become unpromising. Similarity pruning can discard distinct correct paths, and verbal confidence can be miscalibrated. More importantly, token reduction alone misses the serving bottleneck: concurrent long traces fill GPU KV cache, force preemption, and create waiting time that can dominate end-to-end latency.

The paper asks which traces should be stopped and when stopping produces a system-level benefit. It needs an early quality signal that is cheap enough to use during decoding, and a trigger aligned with actual resource pressure rather than a fixed token or confidence threshold. The desired policy frees memory before a poor trace causes other useful traces to queue, while retaining enough diversity for final answer selection.

并行采样会改善推理准确率，却会让许多已无前景的长轨迹继续存活。相似度剪枝可能删去不同但正确的路径，语言置信度也可能失准。更重要的是，单纯减少词元忽略了服务瓶颈：并发长轨迹填满 GPU KV 缓存、迫使抢占并制造等待时间，而等待可能主导端到端延迟。

论文研究应停止哪些轨迹，以及何时停止才能带来系统级收益。它需要一个在解码期间足够便宜的早期质量信号，也需要与真实资源压力一致、而非固定词元或置信度阈值的触发器。理想策略应在差轨迹使有用轨迹排队之前释放内存，同时保留足够多样性供最终答案选择。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
STEP uses the last-layer hidden state at a reasoning-step boundary as an early signal of trace quality. A lightweight two-layer MLP maps this representation to a correctness score, and the running average of step scores ranks active traces. Unlike output confidence or surface similarity, the signal is trained from internal representations that already encode how a reasoning path is developing.

Pruning is coupled to the inference system. STEP does not remove a trace at an arbitrary interval; it watches KV-cache utilization and, at saturation, removes the active trace with the lowest score. This immediately releases memory, avoiding preemption and cache reconstruction. The resulting allocation rule spends compute on the traces most likely to be useful precisely when hardware capacity makes continuing every trace expensive.

STEP 使用推理步骤边界处最后一层隐藏状态作为轨迹质量的早期信号。轻量两层 MLP 将该表示映射为正确性分数，步骤分数的运行平均对活跃轨迹排序。与输出置信度或表面相似度不同，这一信号来自内部表示，而内部表示已编码推理路径如何发展。

剪枝与推理系统耦合。STEP 不在任意间隔删除轨迹；它监视 KV 缓存利用率，并在饱和时移除得分最低的活跃轨迹。这会立即释放内存，避免抢占和缓存重建。所得分配规则恰好在硬件容量使继续所有轨迹昂贵时，把计算花在最可能有用的轨迹上。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method extracts text between think tags, segments steps at double-newline boundaries, and feeds each step-end hidden state to the scorer. Trace-level correctness is propagated to all of its steps as pseudo-labels; balanced correct and incorrect traces are used, with weighted binary cross entropy compensating for longer incorrect traces. The trace score is the average of observed step scores, so it can be updated without a separate model call.

During parallel generation, a KV-cache monitor detects memory saturation. STEP then prunes the lowest-scoring active trace rather than allowing the engine to preempt it into a waiting queue. The paper evaluates Qwen3-4B-Thinking, DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, and Phi-4-reasoning-plus on AIME-25, HMMT-24/25, GPQA Diamond, EquiBench, and DivLogicEval, comparing with self-consistency, Slim-SC, and DeepConf.

方法提取 think 标签之间的文本，在双换行边界处分割步骤，并把每个步骤末端隐藏状态送入评分器。轨迹级正确性被传播给其所有步骤作为伪标签；使用平衡的正确与错误轨迹，并以加权二元交叉熵补偿错误轨迹更长的问题。轨迹分数是已观察步骤分数的平均，因此无需额外模型调用即可更新。

并行生成期间，KV 缓存监视器检测内存饱和。随后 STEP 剪去得分最低的活跃轨迹，而非让推理引擎把它抢占到等待队列。论文在 AIME-25、HMMT-24/25、GPQA Diamond、EquiBench 和 DivLogicEval 上评测 Qwen3-4B-Thinking、DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B 与 Phi-4-reasoning-plus，并与自一致性、Slim-SC、DeepConf 比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the reported benchmarks and models, STEP reduces end-to-end latency by 45% to 70% on average relative to self-consistency while improving accuracy by 0.4 to 7.5 points. On DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, the summary figure reports 1.54 times faster average latency together with a 1.7-point accuracy gain over self-consistency across AIME-25, HMMT-24/25, and GPQA Diamond.

The system diagnosis supports the mechanism. In a representative Qwen3-4B setting, incorrect traces average 42.5K completion tokens versus 35.3K for correct traces, and waiting accounts for roughly 40% of end-to-end generation time while decoding accounts for 59%. Hidden-state separation between correct and incorrect traces is visible after the first 25% of steps and improves later, explaining why early score-based memory release can improve both cost and final vote quality.

在报告的基准和模型上，STEP 相比自一致性平均将端到端延迟降低 45% 到 70%，同时将准确率提高 0.4 到 7.5 个点。在 DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B 上，汇总图报告相对自一致性平均延迟快 1.54 倍，并在 AIME-25、HMMT-24/25 和 GPQA Diamond 上提升 1.7 个准确率点。

系统诊断支持其机制。在一个代表性 Qwen3-4B 设置中，错误轨迹平均有 42.5K 完成词元，正确轨迹为 35.3K；等待约占端到端生成时间的 40%，解码占 59%。正确与错误轨迹的隐藏状态分离在前 25% 步骤后就已可见，之后更强，这解释了为何早期基于分数的内存释放能同时改善成本和最终投票质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's novelty is to combine an internal trace-quality signal with a serving-system control point. Prior pruning often treats every token as the relevant cost or treats trace similarity as redundancy. STEP instead asks whether a partial trace is worth retaining when its KV cache is about to displace other work, making memory saturation a first-class part of the test-time scaling policy.

Its pseudo-label design is deliberately lightweight: no human step annotation and no large external reward model are required. That does not make the score a proof of correctness, but it is sufficient for relative pruning. The contribution is therefore not a new final-answer verifier; it is a runtime allocation mechanism that uses early hidden evidence to decide which parallel reasoning futures remain worth paying for.

论文的新意是把内部轨迹质量信号与服务系统控制点结合。既有剪枝常把每个词元视为相关成本，或把轨迹相似性当作冗余。STEP 则问：当某轨迹的 KV 缓存即将挤占其他工作时，这条部分轨迹是否值得保留，从而把内存饱和作为测试时扩展策略的一等组成部分。

它的伪标签设计刻意轻量：不需要人工步骤标注，也不需要大型外部奖励模型。这不会使分数成为正确性证明，却足以进行相对剪枝。因此，贡献不是新的最终答案验证器，而是一种运行时分配机制：用早期隐藏证据决定哪些并行推理未来仍值得继续付费。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Trace correctness pseudo-labels can be wrong at individual steps, and a score trained on one model family may not transfer to another hidden-state geometry. Memory saturation depends on batch size, cache policy, hardware, and serving engine, so the pruning trigger must be recalibrated in deployment. A low score can also remove a rare but correct reasoning route; the method is most appropriate when a parallel pool has enough redundancy to tolerate selective loss.
轨迹正确性伪标签在单个步骤上可能错误，在一个模型族上训练的分数也未必迁移到另一种隐藏状态几何。内存饱和取决于批大小、缓存策略、硬件和服务引擎，因此部署时必须重新校准剪枝触发器。低分也可能移除罕见但正确的推理路径；该方法最适合并行池有足够冗余、能容忍选择性损失的场景。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use STEP when concurrent long reasoning requests cause KV-cache pressure or queueing. Train a small probe on traces from the exact serving model, instrument memory utilization, and evaluate both answer quality and p95 latency under production-like concurrency. Keep a minimum number of active traces and audit pruned paths during rollout, since a capacity-saving rule should not silently erase the only valid but unusual solution strategy.
当并发长推理请求造成 KV 缓存压力或排队时可使用 STEP。应在精确的服务模型轨迹上训练小型探针，插桩内存利用率，并在接近生产的并发下同时评测答案质量与 p95 延迟。保留最少活跃轨迹数，并在 rollout 中审计被剪轨迹，因为节省容量的规则不应悄悄抹去唯一有效但不常见的解法。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The important comparison is end-to-end latency, not only generated tokens. Read the time-distribution and memory-trigger analysis with the accuracy curves: the work is strongest where queueing would otherwise consume a large share of the request budget. The public code is useful for reproducing the scheduler integration, but the learned scorer should be treated as serving-model-specific rather than a portable universal verifier.
重要比较是端到端延迟，而不只是生成词元。应把时间分布和内存触发分析与准确率曲线一起阅读：当排队原本会占据请求预算很大部分时，该工作最有力。公开代码有助于复现调度器集成，但学习到的评分器应被视为服务模型特定的，而非可移植的通用验证器。
